_comment: SDXL change-hair workflow (ComfyUI API format). Same proven shape as replace_object.json. The mask is the HAIR sub-region only (head-region footprint minus an expanded face box, derived in backend/comfy_hair.py), so the face, eyes, eyebrows, ears, clothing, body and background are outside the mask and stay fixed. The init image is the original context crop; SDXL regenerates only the masked hair from the user's prompt at high denoise, anchored by the surrounding fixed latent so lighting/head-shape carry over. The graph STRUCTURE lives here; comfy_hair.py injects per-request VALUES by node id. Flow: load checkpoint -> encode prompts -> VAE-encode the crop -> restrict denoising to the hair mask via SetLatentNoiseMask -> KSampler generates the new hair -> decode -> save.

inputs.text: different face, changed face, deformed face, altered eyes, hat, deformed, blurry, lowres, distorted, artifacts, seam, watermark, text
